title: Prove sharp support29 P112 shortening for three rank-six endpoints
body:
## Summary

```text
Three P112 endpoints of binary rank at most six
  PR3255 sufficient common support: 21
  new sharp common support:        29
  literal counterexample:          30
```

Prove the sharp uniform shortening theorem over every characteristic-zero
field. Each endpoint's total support plus its singleton support is at most
32. The actual orthogonal puncture leaves at least 78 A2 coordinates, giving
98 required incidences against allowance 96 at common support 29.

The focused package includes the proof, complete finite receipts, an actual
thirty-coordinate common cut with exact piece coefficients, source pins,
reproduction commands and open next questions. It permits arbitrary
coefficients, nonmodal shifts and dependent pieces. It supplies no historical
profile application, full C5, decoder floor, supplier or new kappa.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3255 for the quotient and arbitrary-shift argument,
PR3249 and the retained root-simplex geometry, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and
the E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. The concurrent rank-five equality
audit and mixed-rank caller use different endpoint contracts.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the support-only singleton inequality leaves equality at 22.
  **After:** the joint closure inequality proves support 29; the literal
  common-cut-30 witness has binary ranks 6,6,6 and exact code/piece/join ranks
  8,3,9, so the intersection dimension is two.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes all three commands, including
  788,035 six-flats, all 1,120 A2 planes, 381 hyperplanes, 8,001 five-spaces,
  a separate lattice/closure checker and seven optimized behavioral groups.
  Ruff and warnings-as-errors compilation pass.
- Internal read-only peer review found no blocking mathematical or witness
  issue. All eleven reviewed files stayed unchanged; REVIEW.json records
  the checks and unrun obligations. The exact committed read-only Git-free
  CPython 3.13.16 export passes all three commands under optimization, and
  all fourteen package/input byte comparisons pass. The standard
  Weyl-chamber theorem and characteristic-zero argument remain written
  dependencies; no independent human or proof-kernel verification is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-a2-rank6-sharp-shortening
```

https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19003422
